groups.current_evidence_and_nominal: Historical checkboxes are order flags. No receipts verified by this audit; user reports M3 stock. Latest dimensional selections do not imply purchase.
groups.recommendation: One consolidated configuration-specific ledger: reported ordered / receipt verified / selected candidate / still needed / superseded. Keep counts for one test set separate from four-station total.
groups.dependencies_and_test: Chosen architecture, exact hardware interfaces, user inventory.
groups.acceptance_evidence: Photographs/labels or explicit user receipt confirmation; compare actual variant and dimensions to source drawing; quantity and compatibility checked before printing/ordering four sets.
groups.next_step: Reconcile historical BOM into configuration-specific selection/order/receipt records; no automatic purchase inference.
groups.closure_gate: W11 or an earlier independently reviewed complete group closure

work_packages.title: Scope, architecture profiles and coordinate contracts
work_packages.definition_of_done: Scope/profile and datum contracts, explicit acceptance/error-budget targets and transport/connector study recorded. Homing and IMU procedure decisions can be selected here; their physical calibration closes later.

work_packages.title: Room, components, mass and preliminary load/model survey
work_packages.definition_of_done: Room/part/COM survey and preliminary finite-body force/moment/load envelope recorded. This is design-input maturity; final supported workspace/tension qualification remains W09.

work_packages.title: Outlet, bead, guides and secured switch
work_packages.definition_of_done: One coherent cartridge/bracket/cover clears routing, all screw seats and service paths; qualified bead approach, switch margins, reset and retention demonstrated.

work_packages.title: Shaft, spool, hub, payout and encoder
work_packages.definition_of_done: Mechanical shaft/spool/magnet interfaces and controlled payout/retention experiments defined and performed where the protected fixture permits. Local powered torque/feedback evidence joins W05/W07 results before group closure.

work_packages.title: Power, harness, fuse, enclosure and thermal layout
work_packages.definition_of_done: Exact retained power/harness/connector geometry and protection design fit the selected transport profile. Enclosed powered current/thermal evidence is gathered jointly with W04/W07; wire bends cannot be inferred from component bodies.

work_packages.title: Dock, structural sections and printable process
work_packages.definition_of_done: Directional structural calculations and actual-process coupons/joint/load/creep tests support explicit working envelope; assembly/service tool checks and exports pass.

work_packages.title: Motion execution, synchronized four-axis control and faults
work_packages.definition_of_done: Actual firmware target compiles; pulse timing/clock/segment/fault tests pass; machine-wide supported stop/recovery policies verified, without auto-resume after boot/link loss.

work_packages.title: Extended clamp, horn, pads and passive attitude
work_packages.definition_of_done: Physical horn and joint stacks, travel stops, rail/gear fits, cloth retention, extension flex and near-level settled acceptance tested.

work_packages.title: Validated full-body workspace, pose and collision limits
work_packages.definition_of_done: Measured finite-body model, cable friction/payout and all body/cable/garment obstacles constrain every path; supported pose/tilt/tension validation closes tolerances.

work_packages.title: Moving camera, image age and pickup/delivery evidence
work_packages.definition_of_done: Intrinsics/extrinsics and per-image camera pose calibrated; stale/occluded observations rejected; camera-only motion and failed pickup/release negative tests do not mark success.

work_packages.title: Inventory, versioned print/order and end-to-end commissioning
work_packages.definition_of_done: One consistent hardware/software/print version with real inventory and remaining orders; staged restrained tests followed by verified pickup/probe/delivery cycle and documented limits.

package_policy: Work-package dependencies order research/design milestones; parameter references show contributions, not automatic group closure. Powered station/power/thermal and full workspace gates require iterative joint evidence. No package alone validates all referenced groups.
canonical_alias_policy: Alias fields reference the same underlying record; do not independently fill duplicate geometry/mass/extrinsic facts. Validator checks equality when both values exist; unit conversions require explicit new contract.
reference_value_policy: Reference values record existing supplier/user/CAD/code facts. They do not replace actual measured_value/resolved_value, close a physical group or enable runtime motion.
